name: cobbleandcandle/values
title: Values
description: Three short promises with icons. One per line: icon | Title | Text (icons: flame, leaf, clock, star, glass, users).

items.default:
flame | Lit by hand | Every candle and lamp is lit at dusk by the front-of-house team.
leaf | Coast & garden | Fish from boats we know by name; vegetables from two walled gardens.
clock | Nothing rushed | Two seatings a night, so your table is yours for the evening.
